name: zora_river
label: Zora's River
about: Pieces and textures cut from Zora's River (spot03). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where Zora's River draws them). `ground` is the grass camo of every bank and top (no detail texture), `riverbed`, `_b` and `_c` the dark rock under the water, `water` the river (`water_b` its rapids, `water_c` the waterfall pool). `cliff` is the gorge's big rock face with grass at its top and foot (cut out at the top: its skyline), `cliff_b` the low banks with a grass lip, `cliff_moss` the faces with moss hanging from their lip; the `cliff_side` textures are the same rock turned on its side (the lip runs along u). `stone_post` is the mossy block of the posts and walls, `bridge_log` and `bridge_post` the log bridge, `fence` the rope fence, `iron_fence` the spiked railing, `plaque` the lullaby slab, `tunnel_wall` the passage to Zora's Domain.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: zr_log_bridge
pieces.label: Log bridge
pieces.about: Twelve lashed logs (120 wide, 380 long) dipping 30 between pointed posts, over the river where the upper gorge begins. Its floor is planks; low invisible sides keep Link on it.

pieces.name: zr_mossy_log
pieces.label: Mossy log bridge
pieces.about: A narrow log (45 wide, 190 long) with moss hanging under it, from the ledge to the Gossip Stone pillar's top.

pieces.name: zr_gossip_pillar
pieces.label: Gossip Stone pillar
pieces.about: A mushroom of rock: a grassy top 360 across, 440 up on a slim stem, where the Gossip Stone stands (an actor, not included). In the game only the top collides; the stem doesn't.

pieces.name: zr_pillar_tall
pieces.label: Grassy pillar, tall
pieces.about: A square column of rock 320 tall with a grassy top, standing in the upper river (a Piece of Heart sat on it).

pieces.name: zr_pillar
pieces.label: Grassy pillar
pieces.about: A wide square column of rock 220 tall with a grassy top, standing in the upper river.

pieces.name: zr_pillar_low
pieces.label: Grassy block
pieces.about: A grass-topped block 170 square standing 55 out of the riverbed: a stepping stone.

pieces.name: zr_frog_logs
pieces.label: Frogs' logs
pieces.about: Three fallen logs lying in the shallow upper river, where the frogs sing (the frogs are actors). Link can stand on them.

pieces.name: zr_stone_post
pieces.label: Stone post
pieces.about: A mossy stone block post, 30 square and 120 tall.

pieces.name: zr_iron_fence
pieces.label: Iron fence with post
pieces.about: A stone post (120 tall) with a spiked iron fence (64 tall, 200 long) running from it, by the bean seller; a second one guards the ledge south of the Gossip Stone pillar. Its sides don't let Link grab them.

pieces.name: zr_stone_wall
pieces.label: Stone wall corner
pieces.about: An L of mossy stone blocks 160 tall (200 by 280, 40 thick) at the river's mouth, beside the bombable boulders.

pieces.name: zr_fence
pieces.label: Rope fence
pieces.about: Posts and rope 593 long along the upper gorge's north bank, climbing 140 at its east end. Room 1 has a copy.

pieces.name: zr_fence_corner
pieces.label: Rope fence, corner
pieces.about: Posts and rope round a corner (160 and 120 long), on the south bank by the log bridge.

pieces.name: zr_fence_short
pieces.label: Rope fence, short
pieces.about: A short bent run of posts and rope (120 and 160 long), on the ledge below the Gossip Stone pillar.

pieces.name: zr_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder, tall
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 390 tall up the cliff by the river's first bend. Climbable (wall type ladder); locked at its size.

pieces.name: zr_ladder_short
pieces.label: Ladder, short
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 165 tall from the waterfall's pool to the ledge above; its top is a ladder-top wall. Locked at its size.

pieces.name: zr_spire
pieces.label: Rock spire
pieces.about: A three-sided spike of rock 150 tall, one of three in the waterfall's pool.

pieces.name: zr_plaque
pieces.label: Lullaby plaque
pieces.about: The stone slab (100 by 160) on the ledge before the waterfall where Link plays Zelda's Lullaby. Flat: it lies on the ground, with a floor of its own.

pieces.name: zr_domain_passage
pieces.label: Passage to Zora's Domain (exit)
pieces.about: The passage behind the waterfall (the waterfall is an actor): a stone doorway 120 wide and 120 high, then a mossy corridor 380 deep. The exit floor starts 260 in.
